jd.job_title: Senior Product Manager, Core Platform (Customer Portal & Data Delivery)
required_skills: 8+ years product management experience; multiple products shipped end-to-end, including at least one B2B web/SaaS platform owned full lifecycle
Enterprise and startup experience (large corporation + startup)
Technical fluency — comfortable leading discussions on APIs, data pipelines, reliability metrics; can lead a technical design review
Deep customer empathy and discovery skills — turn messy field reality into prioritized problem list with enterprise stakeholders
Evidence of ownership at scale — defined scope for product line/platform, committed, delivered, made hard tradeoffs
Excellent written communication — crisp PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, status the team can act on
preferred_skills: Direct experience in robotics, autonomy, or computer vision products
Experience with B2B customer portals, dashboards, or data-delivery products
Familiarity with SLAs, observability, or reliability engineering concepts
Experience navigating enterprise procurement, IT, and security reviews — or customer-side asset management / capital planning
key_responsibilities: Own customer problem — run discovery with enterprise stakeholders, field teams, deployment engineers; turn into evidence-backed prioritized problem list fitting asset lifecycle / budget / procurement reality
Own roadmap and scope for Customer Portal and Data Delivery pipeline — define, sequence, commit scope; make tradeoffs; replace vague acceptance criteria with crisp ones
Partner with HRI and Platform & Data Delivery engineering daily — lead technical discussions turning customer problem into elegant solution across full loop (robot capture → customer deliverable)
Run disciplined intake — rank customer feedback > field/deployment engineers > dev engineers; loudest wish never outranks real need
Keep platform coherent — field cross-vertical asks, spot duplication, ensure shared capabilities built once and transfer everywhere
Establish data metrics — own platform usage analytics and SLA metrics; close loop with usage + field feedback; retire what isn't landing; double down on what is
Support planning cadence — help Lead PM run L-cycle planning; consolidate vertical roadmaps into one company roadmap
Raise the bar — set standard for discovery, PRDs, and acceptance criteria on Core team

Computer Vision (ATS keyword) (YOLOv8n toothbrush detection (83% mAP@50, exported ONNX/TFLite); U-Net segmentation BraTS 2020 MRI (VGG-16/19/ResNet-50); OpenCV metal surface inspection pipeline (PSNR 86, ZoeDepth ±8% error); OpenCV + YOLO across COFFIN capstone and turrets)

Robotics (ATS keyword) (ROS-Based Robotic Arm AL5B & UR5e (DH parameters, forward kinematics, MoveIt, RViz, ROS2 Humble + ROS Noetic, UR ROS2 driver); COFFIN voice-controlled arm (Flutter + Flask-SocketIO + Jetson + Arduino); Agnel Robotics Club General Secretary — led 25-member team, EAGLE PCB fabrication, UART/I2C sensor comms)
